1500 DS Spirits - Mahjong V.name: 1500 DS Spirits: Mahjong V
1500 DS Spirits - Mahjong V.summary: 1500DS Spirits: Mahjong V (widely used English translation. Original name is "1500 DS spirits: 麻雀V") is a Japan exclusive mahjong game. It is part of a large series of Nintendo DS titles which focus on table games all labeled 1500DS Spirits and created and published by Tasuke Co. Ltd.. This game is a special addition version of 1500DS Spirits: Vol 1 Mahjong and has extra added features compared to that game. This game used 1500DS Spirits: Vol 1 Mahjong as a base for this game so it has some similarities to this game including borrowed modes and assets.

Tago Akira no Atama no Taisou - Dai-1-sh.name: Tago Akira no Atama no Taisou Dai-1-Shuu: Nazotoki Sekai Isshuu Ryokou
Tago Akira no Atama no Taisou - Dai-1-sh.summary:
Puzzle game developed and produced by Level-5 and released on June 18th, 2009. It was released as part of the companies "Atamania" series of games, and is the first in the "Tago Akira no Atama Taisou" subseries.

It's based on lateral thinking puzzles by Akira Tago, who also contributed to Level-5's Professor Layton series. The gameplay consists of solving a series of brain teasers, in order to advance to other locations in a themed map. Each game in the series has a different theme, namely: World Travel, Space, Fairy Tales, and Time Travel.

The cover artwork was done by Manga artist Susumu Matsushita.
